reject_reason: Ten concepts you should know in 2026, handed over as YouTube links, is a vocabulary list. The caption names its own audience, 'if you're building with AI', which is the builder audience POSITIONING.md §8 tells us not to publish for, and a list for its own sake is a named Radar disqualifier in RULES.md §2. The near miss is real and worth recording: Emma has 'The difference between a chat, an automation and an agent' and 'What agents can do today versus what the demos promise' in her list, so the words are in her file. What is missing is the job. There is no repeated process behind any of the ten, no owner and nothing to decide on Monday, so none of the three would forward it. It stays a reference.
